name: runtime.inspect
description: Inspect live windows, or a window's bounded semantic tree. Use its opaque token with runtime.input or runtime.capture; inspect again after StaleDevelopmentTarget. Bounds use logical window coordinates and may extend beyond clips.

name: runtime.input
description: Route one click, hover, scroll, key, or text action through the live window. Requires a fresh inspection token. Pointer actions require a semantic target path. Text types printable UTF-8 into the focused field; control characters and active IME composition are rejected. Key names are tab, enter, space, escape, backspace, delete, home, end, page_up, page_down, arrow_left, arrow_right, arrow_up, arrow_down, and lowercase letters. Returns after runnable callbacks, reconciliation and backend frame submission, not display presentation or asynchronous task completion. Errors or cancellation do not undo callbacks already run.

name: runtime.capture
description: Replay a live window's current scene to a private PNG. This is software_scene_replay, not GPU readback. Requires a fresh inspection token. Returns a local path retained until four later captures or instance exit; copy it to keep it.

name: runtime.diagnostics
description: Read the active source name, source generation and latest structured reload diagnostic. Does not evaluate Lua or change application state.

name: runtime.metrics
description: Read actual successful CPU build/layout/paint counts and timings, input-event and backend-submission counts, and retained resource counts. These are not GPU timings or input-to-presentation latency. Omit window to list all live windows.
